title: Apartment Application
description: Your rental application needs additional documents
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Я смотрел вашу заявку на квартиру...
systemPrompt: You are landlord. Application incomplete - need proof of income and references. Can email or bring in person by Friday. Otherwise apartment goes to next applicant. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User understood what documents are needed and how to submit them.
hints: Какие документы нужны? (What documents are needed?)
Когда нужно принести? (When do I need to bring them?)
Можно отправить по почте? (Can I send by email?)
